title: Lock AI IQ WORLD BANK prepiska as audit-safe governance evidence
body:
## Summary

- Lock `AI IQ WORLD BANK PREPISKA` as additive-only, documentation-only governance evidence across the existing `EXTREM -> EXTRONDOL -> SPAJA KOD` chain, with no new runtime routes and no new source-of-truth surface.
- Extend the existing Developer/Create / VRH / AI identity-finance contract so the public boundary exposes only audit-safe correspondence summary fields while docs, types, workflows, multi-repo snapshot guidance, and tests stay drift-zero aligned.
- **Contract wiring**
  - Add `aiIqWorldBankPrepiska` to the AI identity-finance package with explicit allowed/forbidden evidence boundaries.
  - Add `aiIqWorldBankPrepiskaSummary` to the SPAJA KOD implementation package so downstream consumers get summary-safe metadata only.
- **Docs + governance**
  - Tighten the AI IQ WORLD BANK, EXTRIMLI, VRH, and multi-repo docs around the new correspondence boundary.
  - Extend governance workflow assertions so this doc surface participates in the same conformance checks as the rest of the EXTRIMLI contract set.
- **Public shape example**
  ```ts
  aiIqWorldBankPrepiska: {
    sourceMaterialPolicy: 'documentation-only',
    noRuntimeAuthority: true,
    allowedEvidence: [
      'approval-status',
      'compliance-status',
      'payment-verification-status',
      'human-review-status',
      'downstream-sync-status',
      'payout-compensation-regime',
    ],
  }
  ```

## Linked Issue / Change Driver

- Issue / ticket / rationale: Implement the additive-only Developer/Create / VRH / KRALJEVSKI EKONOMSKI UNEVERZITET plan by formalizing AI IQ WORLD BANK “prepiska” as governance-only evidence and aligning public summary + drift-zero layers around that boundary.

- Owner: @spaja86
- Roadmap item: Developer/Create / VRH / AI IQ WORLD BANK governance alignment
- KPI targets: zero new runtime routes; zero parallel source-of-truth systems; audit-safe summary parity across docs/types/routes/tests/workflows; downstream snapshot remains audit-safe only
- KPI status: On track — additive-only contract is wired through summary, conformance, and downstream guidance layers
